# H1
Charles Owen My PS Replacement Headband

# META TITLE
Charles Owen My PS Replacement Headband

# META DESCRIPTION
The Charles Owen My PS Replacement Headband is a Mips cup headband with hook-and-loop fixing, machine washable and made to fit six Charles Owen helmets.

# SHORT DESCRIPTION
The Charles Owen My PS Replacement Headband is designed to refresh the fit and feel of your helmet for riders who use their My PS, or another compatible Charles Owen helmet, regularly.

- **Type:** Mips cup replacement headband, so you can renew the removable headband without changing the rest of the helmet.
- **Compatibility:** six Charles Owen helmets that take a Mips cup headband, including the My PS, matched to your helmet size.
- **Function:** swaps a worn headband for a new one, for a cleaner, fresher feel inside the helmet.
- **Fit:** hook-and-loop attachment, giving a precise fit with no pressure points.

See Compatibility, Function & fitting and Material & comfort below for the full details.

# LONG DESCRIPTION
## Compatibility
**Compatible hats:** This Mips cup headband fits the Charles Owen [Esme JS1 Pro](https://www.discount-equestrian.co.uk/charles-owen-esme-cosmic-js1-pro.html), [Harlow JS1 Pro](https://www.discount-equestrian.co.uk/charles-owen-harlow-js1-pro-pastel-collection.html), Esme MS1 Pro, Harlow MS1 Pro, MS1 Pro and My PS. It comes in sizes 52 to 62 cm, plus Round fit sizes 56R to 58R; choose the model and the size printed on your helmet's label.

**Usage restrictions:** Only helmets that originally came with a removable headband can take a replacement, and different Charles Owen models use different headbands. A new headband does not extend the protection your helmet offers, and Charles Owen advises replacing riding hats every 3 to 5 years.

## Function & fitting
**Function:** Charles Owen recommends replacing the headband regularly, to keep the helmet fitting snugly and performing at its best.

**Fitting:** The headband fixes inside the helmet with premium hook-and-loop fastenings. It is fully removable, so you can lift it out to wash it or swap in a new one.

## Material & comfort
**Properties:** The headband is machine washable, and Charles Owen designed it to give the comfiest possible fit inside the helmet.

## About the brand
[Charles Owen](https://www.discount-equestrian.co.uk/shop-by-brand/charles-owen.html) was founded in 1911 by Charles Owen, whose mission was to make products 'for a safer world'. It began with military helmets for the British Army in the First World War, then moved into motorsport headwear. Rebranded in 2025 and based at the award-winning Royal Works in Wrexham, it is a leading British maker of riding helmets.

As an authorised Charles Owen stockist, [discount-equestrian.co.uk](https://www.discount-equestrian.co.uk/) offers genuine, manufacturer-backed replacement headbands. We are a UK equestrian retailer with 14 years' experience supplying horse riding clothes and horse supplies, with riding hats a key product, and every hat bought in store comes with a free professional fitting and 30-day returns.
